title: Project 1: Expository Visualization
description: A single static visualization that communicates one takeaway about a dataset of over 50,000 grocery store foods from Walmart, Target, and Whole Foods, with a short write-up of the design rationale.

title: Project 2: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization?
description: A group project that crafts two opposing visualizations of the same dataset, one for each side of a proposition, to explore where persuasion ends and deception begins.
